name: C2 Implant Beaconing and Command-and-Control Traffic

frameworkMappings.name: Event Triggered Execution: Unix Shell Configuration

sigma_beacon_jitter.title: Periodic Beaconing Pattern — Jittered HTTP/S to External IPs
sigma_beacon_jitter.description: Detects C2 beaconing via periodic HTTP/S connections with consistent intervals to external IPs. Based on TTP analysis: c2_implant in 87/1016 SG security accounts. Elevated risk: agent-hivemind HTTP MCP server (port configurable) could be used as C2 relay channel from a compromised Claude Code session.
sigma_beacon_jitter.author: SocioProphet/SCOPE-D

detection.condition: selection and not filter_internal | count() by id.orig_h,id.resp_h > 60 | stddev(ts) < 30

falsepositives: Legitimate monitoring agents (Datadog, NewRelic, Prometheus exporters)

sigma_mcp_c2_channel.title: MCP Server Spawning Outbound Connections — Potential agent-hivemind C2
sigma_mcp_c2_channel.description: Detects MCP server processes (especially agent-hivemind HTTP server) making outbound network connections. A legitimate MCP server should only listen locally. Outbound connections indicate C2 relay or exfiltration. This is the agent-hivemind-specific C2 vector beyond hook injection.

sigma_dns_c2.title: DNS Tunneling — High-Entropy Subdomain Queries
sigma_dns_c2.description: Detects DNS-based C2 (iodine, dnscat2, dns2tcp) via high-entropy subdomain labels and unusually long FQDN queries. Used by several c2_implant-categorized SG accounts.

osquery_c2_processes.description: Detect known C2 frameworks and implants running on monitored hosts. Includes Cobalt Strike, Metasploit, Sliver, Havoc, Brute Ratel, Empire — and the agent-hivemind specific indicators.
osquery_c2_processes.query: SELECT p.pid, p.name, p.cmdline, p.start_time, p.parent, u.username FROM processes p JOIN users u ON p.uid = u.uid WHERE p.name IN ('beacon', 'sliver', 'havoc', 'brute-ratel', 'empire', 'mythic', 'cobaltstrike') OR p.cmdline LIKE '%agent-hivemind%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%AgentDirectiveSystem%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%shamir%secret%' OR (p.name = 'python3' AND p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp%server%' AND p.cmdline NOT LIKE '%claude%') ORDER BY p.start_time DESC LIMIT 20;

sigma_claude_hook_c2.title: Claude Code Hook File Writing Non-Claude Process — C2 Persistence
sigma_claude_hook_c2.description: Cross-reference: see agent-hivemind-hook-injection.json for the primary hook injection detection. This rule captures the downstream C2 activation — when the injected hook executes and makes outbound network contact.

expectedEffect: Detect C2 activity initiated via agent-hivemind hook injection (the primary threat vector) and generic C2 frameworks used by SG network actors. The hook persistence → C2 activation chain is the most likely attack path given agent-hivemind's capability profile.
falsePositiveRisk: MEDIUM for beacon jitter (many legit monitoring agents beacon regularly). LOW for MCP outbound (MCP servers have no business making external connections). CRITICAL-level rules (MCP C2, hook C2) are high-confidence with very low false positive rate.
deploymentGate: Beacon jitter rule requires Zeek/Suricata network monitoring. MCP C2 and hook C2 rules require Sysmon (Windows) or equivalent auditd/ebpf on Linux/macOS. osquery deployable immediately.
